ordering_resolution: The first nine exact-main T0705 protected rehearsals failed and all nine heads are frozen at attempt 1 with rerun zero. Live replay proved the canonical Git Blob recovery. The next delivery stopped at pre-Secret Ruff format validation and its successor then stopped even earlier because an Environment-scoped one-shot variable cannot be read by the deliberately pre-Environment authority job; both heads are frozen, and neither reached Secret, Gmail or private-repository access. The new successor keeps data-plane behavior unchanged, binds the one-shot variable at repository scope only after the new exact-main merge exists, executes one workflow_dispatch through the same SCHEDULE planner path and truthful SCHEDULE_REHEARSAL label, then deletes the variable. No soak, observation window or full-suite gate is required. Only after every data-plane, recovery, zero-collateral, cleanup and single-Timeline oracle passes may the committed 04:30 Australia/Sydney schedule be enabled.
rollback: Before protected canonical Git Blob recovery PASS, keep MOOMOOAU_PRODUCTION_ENABLED absent or false and remove every consumed one-shot authority variable. After PASS, a later operational fault disables the schedule variable and preserves the last verified code, Raw and encrypted state.
